CardDescription.DefaultText:
Can be found alongside rivers. Needs mid hydration, mid to high nutrients and low acidity. 

Can be used to make twine and cloth and for its edible leaves. Should handle it with caution due to its stinging hairs.
CardDescription.Text: 可以在河边找到，需要中等湿度、中高养分和低酸度。\n\n可用于制作细线和布料，其叶可食用。它身披毛刺，因此要小心处理。
CardDescription.zh: 可以在河边找到，需要中等湿度、中高养分和低酸度。\n\n可用于制作细线和布料，其叶可食用。它身披毛刺，因此要小心处理。
CardDescription.en: Can be found alongside rivers. Needs mid hydration, mid to high nutrients and low acidity. \n\nCan be used to make twine and cloth and for its edible leaves. Should handle it with caution due to its stinging hairs.
CardDescription.ja: 川の近くで見られる。中程度の水分量と中〜高程度の養分、低い酸度を必要とする。\n\n紐や布の素材として利用でき、葉は食用になるが、刺毛があるため注意して扱う必要がある。

CardHelpSection.DefaultText: Found: Oaken Clearings and Oaken River Banks. Growth Needs: Low Acidity, Mid Hydration and Mid to High Nutrients. Benefits: Textiles.
CardHelpSection.Text: 产地：橡树区域的河岸和林隙。 需求：低酸度、中等湿度、中高养分。 用途：纺织。
